// file: Managed settings. root owns this file, and no project, local or user file can override a key here. A change needs an image rebuild.

permissions.// deny: Blocks GitHub MCP tools that merge, remove files, or create, remove or fork a repository. The proxy cannot read an MCP tool name.
permissions.// additionalDirectories: Makes the Herdr worktrees a working directory. The two block keys below ignore a directory that only a project file adds.
permissions.// disableBypassPermissionsMode: Rejects --dangerously-skip-permissions and permissionMode bypassPermissions in an agent definition.
permissions.// blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories: Read, Grep, Glob and LSP refuse a path outside the working directories. A shell command is not limited.
permissions.// blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse a path outside the working directories and the Claude Code settings files. A shell command is not limited.

// allowManagedHooksOnly: Runs only hooks from this file. A hook from a project, user or plugin file does not run.
// allowManagedMcpServersOnly: Ignores allowedMcpServers from every other file.
// allowedMcpServers: A server that a user, plugin or project adds must match a URL here. The URL is the control, because a user can choose any name. managedMcpServers skip this check, so these entries repeat them on purpose.
// managedMcpServers: The MCP servers of the agent. The proxy allows only these hosts. The GitHub token is a placeholder that the proxy replaces.
